title: Nashville Shores Waterpark
specs: Waterpark with rides, slides, wave pool, lazy river, and dry activities
Pontoon boat rentals on Percy Priest Lake with up to 8 passengers
Special events like Pooch Pool Party for dogs and owners
Driver's license required to rent pontoon boats
Operator minimum age 21 years old for boat rentals
Riders 12 years and younger must wear life jackets on boats
Pets must be spayed/neutered and show proof of rabies vaccination for Pooch Pool Party
Birthday party packages for groups, max 15 additional guests
RV rallies hosted, usually minimum 25 sites

blurb: Guests can enjoy a waterpark with rides, slides, and dry activities. Pontoon boat rentals are available on Percy Priest Lake. Lodging options include RV sites and cabins with amenities and discounts on park attractions.
extraNote: No refunds for weather; rain checks only if park closes for the day · Cancellation for boat rentals requires 48 hours notice or deposit forfeited · Cabin/RV lodging cancellations require 10 days notice for refund, $25 fee applies · General Store for lodging check-in; Marina at Nashville Shores for boat rentals
